a11y: A real <table> with <th scope="col"> headers, so screen readers read the column name with each cell.
The caption names the table; screen readers read it first even though it's shown underneath.
On small screens the table scrolls sideways inside its frame instead of squashing the columns. The frame can be scrolled with the keyboard (tabindex="0" with a label).
